syllabary: ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎤᎵᏬᏨ ᏗᎦᎾᏗ ᏣᏄᏍᏕᎢ,
phonetic: gó:sda:yi digá:hlti:sdóhdi gá:ye:sadv´:'i u:li:hwo:tsv di:gandi tsinu:sdei,

syllabary: ᎠᏎᏃ ᏥᏳᎧᏗ ᎤᎾᏕᎶᎰᏍᏗ ᏧᎾᏚᎵᏍᎨ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏍᎩᏳᏍᏗ ᎡᏆ ᏧᏃᏔᏁᎢ
phonetic: aseno tsiyú:gdi u:ndeló:hosdi tsundu:lísge ani:tsalagi sgi:yú:sdi é:gwa tsuno:tané:'i
english: but to make sure, the Cherokees built a big fire
and threw the witch on it.

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᎠᏥᎳ ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏴᏫ ᏣᎾᏴᎩᏍᎨ
phonetic: sgiyvhno atsí:la agó:hvsgv´ hí'a ani:yv:wiyá tsani:tv:gí:sge
english: As the fire burned, the people heard
songs coming from the fire, songs of healing.

syllabary: ᏍᎩᏴ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ ᎠᏓᏪᎯ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏍᏗ ᎩᎳᎯᏯ ᏧᏂᏲᏍᏓᏁᎢ,
phonetic: sgiyv u:so:nv´'i adawé:hi go:sdáyi digá:tisdóhdi gá:yesad(i) kilá:hí:ya tsuni:yó:sdané:'i,
english: When the evil magic of Spearfinger was finally destroyed,

syllabary: ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ ᏧᎾᏛᏓᏍᏓᏁᎢ ᏃᎴ ᏧᎾᎾᎾᏖᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎧᏃᎩᏓ ᎯᎪᎢᎦ.
phonetic: hí'a ani:tsalagi unatvganv nole unanta sgina dikahno:gí:da hi:go í:ga.
english: The Cherokees listened, and they remember those songs to this day.
